Hi, Is anybody here trying the function matrixInput() ?

This is a function in the package "incubator",
 Run these code to install package:

install.packages("devtools")
library(devtools)
install_github('shiny-incubator', 'rstudio')
library(shinyIncubator)

I tried this function, it seems the function cannot read data. No output shows.

I also tried the example of this function.  (you can run it using shiny::runGist('https://gist.github.com/3960092') ).
there should be a plot. but there is no graphes.

What's the problem? did I not install the package correctly?

Thank you for your attention!
